tn.title: NumeriDuel · Teacher dashboard
tn.per_student_caveat: students use codes, no real names (FERPA-light)
tn.roster_hint: One code per line (or comma separated). Codes only — never real names.
tn.assign_note: Room codes are created server-side. Students open the invite link and enter their class code — no account needed. We store only student codes, never real names, to keep this FERPA-light.
tn.board_note: Classroom board mode: ad-free, large-type, live standings — built for projector display.
tn.compliance: Teacher-managed · FERPA-light. Students join by code; we keep only anonymous codes, not real names. COPPA/GDPR handled on the game side.
tn.hint_login: Sign in with your NumeriDuel account to open your classes.
tn.hint_signup: Create a free account — teachers and players share the same account system. We’ll email you a verification link.
tn.err_login_verify: Please verify your email first — we sent you a link when you registered.
tn.err_reg_email: That email address doesn’t look right.
tn.err_reg_pwshort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
tn.err_reg_exists: This email already has an account — switch to Sign in.
tn.err_reg_iplimit: Too many sign-ups from this network today — try again tomorrow.
tn.err_reg_emailsvc: Sign-up is temporarily unavailable — please try again later.
tn.err_verify_sent: Account created! Check your inbox for the verification link, then sign in here.
tn.toast_first_class: Create your first class to start
tn.confirm_del_class: Delete class "{name}" with all its assignments and reports? This cannot be undone.
tn.trend_need_two: Finish at least two assignments to see the class trend line.
tn.skm_legend: Green ≥80% · amber 40–79 · red <40 · "·" = not attempted yet. Every recommendation starts from evidence you can open and check.
tn.weak_no_attempts: No attempts yet — students need to finish a round first.
tn.weak_not_24: Operator breakdown applies to 24-Point assignments. Per-student accuracy is shown below.
tn.note_summary: Summary based on accuracy and completion.
tn.note_gap: {sym} combinations are the class’s biggest gap — worth a reteach.
tn.note_ontrack: No major gaps — the class is on track.
tn.no_students: No student codes yet. Add a roster, or let students join with the room code.
tn.empty_assign: Assign your first practice to see class data.
tn.toast_pick_class: Pick or create a class first
tn.toast_room_ready: 🚀 Room {code} ready — share with the class
tn.toast_qr_unavailable: ▦ QR unavailable — use the invite link instead
tn.confirm_del_asg: Delete this assignment and its report? This cannot be undone.
